state.context: Can P10 specifies immutable opaque HTTP responses, native Request/Response/Headers, complete awaited named callbacks, and conversion exactly once. No linear response consumption is specified; immutable Can values may be reused by callbacks. Native Response bodies are consumable. Exact static GET/POST routes match decoded normalized request paths; no implicit HEAD, captures or wildcards. URL performs normalization before decodeURIComponent. Errors include duplicate_route(method,path) and ambiguous_route(first,second). Different textual paths can normalize to one decoded path. There are zero compatibility requirements. These choices concern private representation and collision handling, not new public operations.

response.instructions: Which response representation best preserves these immutability and boundary requirements?

criteria.snapshot: Keep status, validated headers and immutable payload privately; construct a fresh native Response once for each completed dispatch, allowing the same Can value in later requests.
criteria.consume: Mark each Can response consumed upon its first conversion and fail any subsequent dispatch that returns it.
criteria.cache: Cache one native Response inside the Can value and hand that same native object to every dispatch.

routes.instructions: Which exact-route collision policy best implements the declared normalization and error surface?

criteria.collision: Normalize every valid static spelling with the request algorithm; reject identical same-method spellings as duplicate_route and distinct same-method spellings with equal normalized paths as ambiguous_route; GET and POST may share a path.
criteria.strict: Accept only a single canonical decoded spelling at construction; reject every normalization alias as invalid_route, leaving no normalization collision for make_router.
criteria.overwrite: Allow normalization collisions and choose the last route for each method and normalized path.
